text: Figure 7.10: SW-C requires state changes within the Communication Manager Module and reads out current communication state In this use case, the SW-C wants to explicitly take influence on the communication- state of the physical channels it needs. The SW-C indicates this by a specific port. Through this port, the SW-C can then request the Communication Manager Module mode "No Communication" or "Full Communication". The Communication Manager Module will use these calls to request the corresponding communication mode from the corresponding Bus State Manager module.
